admission.mechanism: existing bootstrap feature-admission (S20-230 owner amendment path); SH2 primitive-crypto permission, not general FFI
admission.reachability: admitted contract plus implementation and vectors in RW-075; host-import wiring belongs to the RW-080 construction manifest (BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_1 NOT broadened here)

algorithm.name: BLAKE3-256
algorithm.reference: audited blake3 =1.8.2 crate (the exact pin already carried by sley-id); no Sley-side reimplementation exists or is permitted
algorithm.variant_selector: u32 exact match on 1; every other variant refuses with UnknownVariant without hashing (default deny; no fallback, no negotiation)

design_principle: Sley constructs the exact semantic and domain-separated preimage as Bytes; the host performs a narrow audited primitive hash over those bytes and adds no domain, prefix, canonicalization, or judgment

failure.unknown_variant: UnknownVariant for any algorithm tag other than 1

forbidden_natives: any other native semantic digest service

fuel.charged_by: the caller through the existing charge_action mechanism when invoked as a host import (RW-080 wiring)

input.max_note: the frozen 1 MiB bridge ceiling, NOT the 64 MiB image ceiling; larger compiler preimages are chunked by the Sley driver

inventory_note: full obligation inventory lives in machineresearch/sley-2.0/reweave/rw-075-hash-inventory.md; host-only SHA-256 artifact hashes (image, package sections) remain host mechanics outside this primitive

output.shape: exact 32-byte digest (Bytes of length 32 on the Sley side)

test_vectors.abc_note: pinned bytes, verified against the reference call in raw_hash tests
test_vectors.tamper: one flipped byte changes the digest; same preimage is deterministic
